medbay_chen_intro.title: Dr. Chen and three cold boxes
medbay_chen_intro.desc: Half the lights in the medbay are off. Dr. Chen is crouched on the floor counting three cold boxes stamped with a pharma batch number. "Serum samples," she says. "They collect them tomorrow, then burn them. This disease is treatable."

steal_samples.text: Help her move the boxes out
steal_samples.outcome: You pushed them out the back and into a corpse cart. She said nothing the whole way, then, at the door: "I'm Chen Jing. If you hadn't come, I'd have died here tonight."

buy_meds.outcome: She took the money, gave you two boxes of antipyretics and nudged the cold boxes further into the corner. You heard her lock the door behind you.

report_her.outcome: Thirty credits. Next day every light in the medbay was on and two pharma vans pulled up. When they took her away she was still holding a vial.

medbay_chen_raid.title: Four company men at the door
medbay_chen_raid.desc: Unmarked black uniforms, a clipboard. "Three cold boxes. Serial 7741 through 7743." The one in front slaps it on the table. "Dr. Chen. Don't make this difficult."

block.text: Stand in front of the boxes
block.outcome: The first blow caught your ribs and your breathing changed sound. They left without the boxes, but they took your ID badge.

handover.outcome: The boxes went into the van, four men working efficiently. Dr. Chen watched from the end of the corridor. She didn't cry. She buttoned her coat, one button at a time.

swap.outcome: Thirty credits bought three identical empty boxes, filled with ice and saline. They weighed them and said, "Next time, be quicker."

medbay_chen_daughter.title: Her daughter is in B sector
medbay_chen_daughter.desc: Dr. Chen sets a photograph on the table, corners worn round. "Fourteen. B sector quarantine camp, number 2291." She slides a transfer form across. "You have signing authority."

pull_strings.text: Use your authority to get her out
pull_strings.outcome: You signed her out as a medical volunteer. The girl came through thin as a shadow. She didn't run to her mother. She just stood there.

admit_powerless.text: Tell her you can't sign it
admit_powerless.outcome: She put the photograph away and said, "I know." Then she went back to work and did eleven debridements that day without a word.

sell_hope.text: Take the money and promise to try
sell_hope.outcome: Twenty-five credits. She asked you every week how it was going. You said soon, every week. In week four she stopped asking.

medbay_trial.title: Twelve vials left
medbay_trial.desc: Twelve trial doses in the cold box. Forty critical cases in the corridor. "By protocol this needs phase three," Dr. Chen says. "By body count, it needs to happen now."

run_trial.outcome: Nine fevers broke. Three didn't. You wrote "75% effective" in the record and found your hand shaking when you finished.

block_trial.outcome: You locked the box in the cabinet. Authorisation came in three days. By then two were dead and ten were still waiting. The form said approved, patient assumes risk.

sell_trial.text: Sell it on the black market
sell_trial.outcome: Sixty credits, one transaction. Twelve vials went into a private clinic in C sector that night at eighty each. You heard it saved people. You heard it killed people.

medbay_chen_choice.title: The samples can only go one place
medbay_chen_choice.desc: Dr. Chen puts the cold box on the table. The thermometer reads minus eighteen. "Three buyers," she says. "Quarantine control, the camps, or your boat. Choose."

broadcast_formula.outcome: Three hours reading the process out loud, and Nadia's transmitter carried it four hundred kilometres. By the next day four camps were compounding their own.

trade_berth.text: Trade it to quarantine control for a berth
trade_berth.outcome: Eighty credits and a handwritten boarding chit. Dr. Chen watched you take the money, then said, "What's in that box could have saved twenty thousand people."

carry_aboard.outcome: You packed the box into your rucksack and let the weight settle on your shoulder. It could save a great many people — if you ever find a lab.

medbay_ward_round.title: Forty beds, forty-nine patients
medbay_ward_round.desc: Nine of them are on stretchers in the corridor. One is still talking. The other eight make no sound at all.

unplug.text: Pull the line on the far bed
unplug.outcome: You were quick and nobody noticed. The bed was free and a nurse had fresh sheets on it inside two minutes. You smoked half a cigarette at the end of the corridor.

share_ration.text: Give your rations to the corridor
share_ration.outcome: Three days of biscuits, handed out. They shared it and left you half a piece. You shook with hunger that day and slept better than you had in weeks.

walk.text: Do the round and do nothing
walk.outcome: You walked all forty beds and remembered every face. Outside, your hand closed into a fist in your pocket.

medbay_quarantine_break.title: The camp wall came down
medbay_quarantine_break.desc: At three in the morning the B sector perimeter was pushed over. Two hundred people who weren't dead yet came through. The medbay door is the only one still locked.

open_ward.outcome: You took sixty-seven. The rest were penned at the junction by riot control. There wasn't a clean patch of floor in the medbay that day.

lock.outcome: The pounding went on for forty minutes. You sat with your back against the door and counted your own heartbeat. Then it went quiet outside.

ticket_only.outcome: Seventeen came in on paper. The rest were shut out. You charged three of them passage — thirty credits total. The paper felt hot in your hand.

medbay_stay_with_chen.title: She says she isn't leaving
medbay_stay_with_chen.desc: Two nights before departure, Dr. Chen is filing records. "There's no lab on that submarine," she says. "There are two thousand patients here. If I go, nobody even writes it down."

stay.outcome: You folded your ticket into a drawer. She looked up once and said, "Think about it." You said you had. That night you filed three hundred records together.

persuade.text: Try to get her on the boat
persuade.outcome: You talked for forty minutes. She didn't argue and didn't agree. Finally: "You go ahead. I'll finish with these patients." You knew she wouldn't come.

leave_alone.outcome: You said nothing and closed the door softly. The corridor was quiet. You could hear her turning pages inside, all the way to the end of the building.
